title: Dhatriloh
description: Dhatriloh is a premier formulation blending Amla (Dhatri) with purified iron, targeting Pitta disorders and blood health. This classical formulation is highly effective for hyperacidity where stomach acid production is excessive. Addresses stomach ulcers and gastritis through protective and cooling action. Helps with premature hair fall through nutritional restoration. Addresses anemia through iron and vitamin C supplementation.
